hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A buyback-and-burn hook that absorbs main-token sells at the pool's own execution price using a BeforeSwapDelta (SHIELD), and executes a capped buy of the main token on every secondary-to-main swap using pot reserves (PUMP). Optionally supports auto-compounding LP fee programs per pool, with configurable compound, buyback, and burn share splits.
